text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару, together with the
other Umamusume, arrive at
Tracen
Academy's seaside facilities for an intense
summer training
camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew... I didn't think I'd sweat this much
before even beginning our
training!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Our main objective for this camp is not
leisure, but training. Yet

Matikanefukukitaru has brought with her a
giant suitcase filled with...
something.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I hope that isn't filled with what I think it is.

text_block_list.text:
I brought my lucky items with me! Or well,
most of them at least. I left
about a
hundred of them back in my dorm room.
The rest are here
with me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to use this summer camp as an
opportunity to say goodbye
to all my stuff.
The question is, how do I go about doing
it?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: How about just throwing it all out?

text_block_list.text:
Throw it all out?! These are all my precious
lucky items! Sure, I'm
getting rid of them,
but I can't just throw them out like some
common
garbage!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Besides, littering is bad. We'd get in
trouble for tossing trash onto the
beach.
I'll admit that I brought all my stuff here
without much of a
plan in mind.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
These lucky items have served me well, so
I'd like to give them a
proper
send-off—but how?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару went from refusing to
let go of her lucky items to
sending them
off on her own. It appears she's gone
through a change
of heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From where that change stems, I don't
know. But regardless, it's
important that I
take her feelings into consideration.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You will?! I'd really appreciate the help!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The sound of chirping crickets and crying
cicadas fills the hot summer
air. Then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are! Be right there!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару spots me and briskly
jogs over to my side.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Why are you here? Where even are we?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hey, there's a little stream over there! I
didn't know this area had a
river so close
by. It really adds to the atmosphere.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect place to play with a toy
boat! Put it in the water
and see what
happens! If it stays afloat, great fortunes
await us! And
if it doesn't... no big deal!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: We're getting rid of your stuff here.

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Here? Ah, are you suggesting we
send off my lucky items using
this river? I
see...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hm... a river memorial. It'd be a fitting way
to put my things to
rest—nice and
traditional.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
River spirits, river lanterns, river
ceremonies... Heck, we even eat
noodles
out of tiny rivers! One of those is not like
the others, but
they've all got to do with
rivers!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I think it's a great idea!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I can reflect on every one of my lucky
items as I let them go and
hopefully
become a better me.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And so begins Матиканэфукукитару's lucky
item river send-off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Farewell, kiddy lunch flag... I was able to
get good test scores back in
elementary
school thanks to you...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You were my motivation to study hard so
Mom would take me out and
get a kiddy
meal...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I suspect the real motivation was nothing
more than her hungry
stomach, but I
decide to remain silent as I watch her send
off the flag
down the stream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next up is one of my most prized lucky
items—this crumpled up
playing card.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Whenever I played using this card, I'd
always win! Its iconic wrinkle
allowed me
to seize victory by my own hands.
Farewell, crumpled
card!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I suppress the urge to make a remark
regarding her clearly fraudulent
antics,
and Матиканэфукукитару releases the card
into the water.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She repeats this process with the
remainder of her lucky items until...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finally, this is the last one! This wooden
doll was given to me by my
grandma. It's
one of my most precious lucky items.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I was always super shy and scared of just
about everything. But my
grandma gave
me this, telling me that she'd be watching
over me no
matter where I am.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
But I'm all grown up now! I've finally
moved on! So please, do the
honors by
sending off my doll for me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Grandma, I think I'll be fine on my own
now! Goodbye!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Матиканэфукукитару's grandmother
is proudly watching her
from the skies
above.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to buy you a little something
before I head back,
Grandma!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I retract my statement. I'm sure she's proud
from the comfort of her
home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... Well, that's the last of it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I feel like a new person! And to top it all
off, my room's finally all
clean!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Now all I need to do is take care not to
cause any more trou— Wait a
second... Oh
no!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I've already caused a huge problem! This
stream... It leads to the
ocean, right?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
We just littered a bunch! Waaaah, what do
we do?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The flustered Матиканэфукукитару panics,
and we decide to follow the
stream down
to its mouth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Who put this metal grate here? It
caught all my lucky items...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Did you do this for me? You really are
prepared for anything, aren't
you? It's like
you can read my mind!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list:
How about we send off your stuff with a small
bonfire instead?

text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! We can make a beachside
campfire and burn
everything there!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Whoa... It's so pretty...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The pile of burning lucky items emits a
soft glow, illuminating the now
dark
beach.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I still have some of my lucky items back in
my dorm room, but I'm still
surprised that I
was able to part with as much as I did...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can completely give up my
divinations or my lucky items
just yet,
but... I think I'm starting to get the
importance of using your
own power to do
things.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm sure the great Shiraoki
wouldn't approve of me solely
relying on
her.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list:
The great Shiraoki would be proud to see you
now.

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It sounds embarrassing when you
put it like that...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I know I'll be just fine! After all, I have the
luckiest person right by
side.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: I'll do what I can to bring you good fortune.

text_block_list.text:
Oho! I hope you mean that. I'm going to
hold you to your word. I
expect lots of
good luck in the near future, got it?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
My arms are wide open! Give me all the
luck you've got!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure which is burning brighter—the
blazing bonfire we made
together, or the
fiery spirit within Матиканэфукукитару's
newly
changed heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
